found: Coursed limestone ashlar on the recipe's own 8 courses of 4 blocks in half bond, with the joints and arrises where the structure puts them. Heavily weathered grey green stone: thick moss and algae washing down from every bed joint, dark soot in the joints, small pale shell inclusions on some faces. Convincing as an old wall and far from the recipe's clean colour. No lettering, numeral, logo, badge, signature, watermark or mason's mark anywhere in the four crops, and nothing that reads as a particular real building.
statement: Every texel of every map is inside exactly one of these crops, each written at 1:1 with no resampling, and each was looked at before this set was offered for publication.
